sampling: Fifteen families, four phases, five fixed paired blocks, two modes. Four 42-input preflights; twenty processes with 4096 timing or 1000 allocation inputs. Separate source-bound Cargo targets; the two completed cost-v2 library builds are reused after correcting only the probe integer cast. All builds ended before probes.
limits: Sources are constructed and proved before first compaction; first does not mean a process-wide cold cache. Equality checks and fact observations occur outside timed/allocation phases and before subsequent warm/cloned phases. Counts describe requested Rust allocations. Probe size includes linked artifact/path effects and is not production executable size.
Every pair/range and adverse row is retained. Timing ratios are descriptive, without significance or application-speedup claims.
Exact value witnesses are checked by the existing tower reducer; this is not an independent implementation or universal proof.
Scalar/direct-solver qualification and these costs do not pass the existing native application gates or complete the full plan.
